interpretation_notes: Physics uses Newton MJWarp; the manager MDP remains Torch eager, with physics and learner graphs separate.
Common deterministic native evaluations measure quality; training return windows differ between runners.
Reported cold_startup/process timings occur after a smoke run. Caches are not cleared, so these are not fully cold machine-start measurements.
Warp compile/capture preparation is separate warmup_seconds; Flash compilation enters early eligible iteration timing. Reported steady_fps excludes the first five iterations.
PPO has unclipped Gaussian actions; FlashSAC has bounded actions. Same registered MDP does not imply identical policy support or update/sample budgets.
Sample efficiency means common evaluation quality versus collected transitions; off-policy replay does not guarantee a wall-time or sample-efficiency win.
Initial model/RNG draws differ between implementations despite matching seeds and PPO recipes. Three-seed quality differences are descriptive.
Walking gate thresholds are success>=0.8, mean planar error<=0.2m/s, survival>=0.9 in forward0.5. Contact traces are measurements, not a natural-gait certification.
dataset_kind: Path-free derived numeric extract; not the original raw measurement JSON.
